split.declaration: parent predicate and 2..8 distinct part predicates, all unary, declared in the request package and mentioned by no definition or inclusion in its closure

axioms.A2_coverage: forall x. parent(x) -> part_1(x) or ... or part_k(x)
axioms.A3_exclusivity: forall x. not (part_i(x) and part_j(x)), i < j

split.axioms_are_fixed: the request cannot add, remove or change an axiom
split.frame: per individual exactly k+1 assignments satisfy the axioms: all false, or parent and exactly one part true

semantics.input: literals over the split vocabulary for one subject that the P0 adoption selection adopted in one context at one view
semantics.not_input: pending, suspected, unreviewed AI candidates and corrected assertions never narrow or settle a candidate set
semantics.candidates: parts j whose model is consistent with the adopted literals and the axioms
semantics.single: one candidate remains by exclusion; derived from the axioms, never an adopted assertion and never a base support
semantics.base: the P0 status of each split atom from the adopted literals; equals the P0 query result because no rule mentions the vocabulary
semantics.no_conversion: no rule maps a split status to a base status; converted_to_base is always false
semantics.unknown_capability: any visible assertion in the context requiring a capability other than the P0 profile and this profile blocks the row, including pending and corrected assertions
semantics.conflict: any adopted positive and negative pair of the same atom in the context blocks the row
semantics.information_request: confirm_part for open, narrowed and single; resolve_split_violation for inconsistent; neither implies a clinical negation

scope.included: one context, one subject, adopted unary atoms of rule-free predicates
scope.excluded: cross-context inference, persistence over time, other subjects, predicates with rules, nested or overlapping splits, probabilities, automatic settlement

steps: one per assertion and one per review before selecting each view in id order
one at each query start in id order within each view
one for each of the k+1 split atoms examined for the query
one before committing each computed row
validation_order: JSON, request, consumer, budget, package, split, query validation before any step
budget_stop: retain completed rows; unfinished rows are blocked with step_limit and carry no candidate set
hashes: native spec raw SHA-256 pinned in handler; snapshot SHA-256 over canonical JSON, UTF-8, sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=false
